levels.name: Block 1 · Getting Started
levels.theme: The computer, the keyboard, the desktop and files

levels.name: Block 2 · Know Your Machine
levels.theme: Hardware, devices, the operating system and fixing problems

levels.name: Block 3 · Online Basics
levels.theme: The browser, search, email and online forms

levels.name: Block 5 · Create, Connect & Stay Safe
levels.theme: Design, media, teamwork, phones and staying safe

levels.name: Block 6 · Code & AI
levels.theme: Scratch, web pages and artificial intelligence

levels.name: Capstone · Final Project
levels.theme: Plan, build and share a digital project

sessions.title: Meet Your Computer
sessions.summary: Input, process and output; desktop vs laptop hardware; safe startup and shutdown; mouse and touchpad control.
sessions.needs: A desktop or laptop computer

sessions.title: Keyboard Mastery & First Typing
sessions.summary: The four keyboard zones, home row, Backspace vs Delete, posture and first typing drills.
sessions.needs: A computer with Notepad (or any typing program)

sessions.title: The Desktop & Programmes
sessions.summary: Desktop anatomy, opening programmes, the three window buttons, moving, resizing and multitasking.
sessions.needs: A computer with Paint and Notepad

sessions.title: Files, Folders & File Explorer
sessions.summary: Files vs folders, the filing hierarchy, File Explorer, the BIH file-naming standard and illegal characters.
sessions.needs: A computer with File Explorer

sessions.title: File Operations & Typing Fluency
sessions.summary: Copy vs cut, renaming with F2, the Recycle Bin, USB drives and safe ejection, typing fluency.
sessions.needs: A computer with File Explorer; a USB pen drive if you have one

sessions.title: Inside the Computer: Processor, Memory & Storage
sessions.summary: The processor, memory (RAM) and storage, the chop bar kitchen, KB to TB, kinds of storage and why computers slow down.
sessions.needs: A computer you can look at (Settings and File Explorer)

sessions.title: Peripherals & Connections
sessions.summary: Input, output and storage devices, ports and cables, Bluetooth, printing well, scanning and using a projector.
sessions.needs: A computer; any printer, headset, webcam or projector you have

sessions.title: Operating Systems & Settings
sessions.summary: What an operating system does, Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, Linux, Android and iOS, accounts, Settings, updates, apps and Task Manager.
sessions.needs: A computer where you may change settings (with your mentor)

sessions.title: Fix-It Day: Troubleshooting
sessions.summary: The fix-it habit: restart, check cables, check settings, then ask. Fix no sound, no internet, a frozen app, a full drive and more.
sessions.needs: A computer, its cables and a headset or speakers

sessions.title: Skills Lab 1: Know Your Machine
sessions.summary: Practice stations: set up a workstation, find a PC's specs, build and back up a folder tree, change settings and fix planted faults.
sessions.needs: A computer, its cables, a USB drive and a headset

sessions.title: The Internet & Your Browser
sessions.summary: Internet vs the Web, how a browser works, tabs, bookmarks, history and downloads, zoom, Find on page and private browsing, URLs and domains, and HTTPS.
sessions.needs: A computer with internet and a web browser

sessions.title: Search Like a Pro
sessions.summary: Search engines vs browsers, keywords and operators, Images, Maps and News, reverse image search and choosing reliable sources.
sessions.needs: A computer with internet and a web browser

sessions.title: Email & Digital Communication
sessions.summary: The digital post office, email addresses, To/Cc/Subject, netiquette and attachments.
sessions.needs: Internet and an email account your mentor gives you

sessions.title: Filling Forms Online
sessions.summary: Form fields, filling an online application accurately, uploads, checking before you submit, saving the confirmation and staying safe.
sessions.needs: A computer with a web browser

sessions.title: Skills Lab 2: Online Basics
sessions.summary: Practice stations: search with sources, bookmarks and downloads, a correct email with an attachment and an error-free online form.
sessions.needs: A computer with internet, an email account, the mentor's email address and a practice Google Form

sessions.title: Create & Format Documents (Part 1)
sessions.summary: Word processor vocabulary, fonts, formatting styles, alignment and fast text selection.
sessions.needs: Microsoft Word, LibreOffice Writer or Google Docs

sessions.title: Create & Format Documents (Part 2)
sessions.summary: Bullets vs numbers, visual hierarchy, built-in styles, spell-check and the Ghanaian name dilemma.
sessions.needs: Microsoft Word, LibreOffice Writer or Google Docs

sessions.title: Documents 3: Real Documents
sessions.summary: Tables, pictures, page layout, headers and footers; a formal letter, an event poster and a programme for a school event.
sessions.needs: Microsoft Word, LibreOffice Writer or Google Docs

sessions.title: Spreadsheets, Tables & Basic Formulas
sessions.summary: The market trader's ledger, cell addresses, data types, formulas, operators and AutoFill.
sessions.needs: Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice Calc or Google Sheets

sessions.title: Functions, Ranges & Visual Charts
sessions.summary: Ranges, SUM/AVERAGE/MAX/MIN, choosing chart types and selecting the right cells.
sessions.needs: Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice Calc or Google Sheets

sessions.title: Online Forms & Surveys
sessions.summary: Build a Google Form with different question types, share it by link or QR code, collect answers and send them to a spreadsheet.
sessions.needs: Internet and a Google account (the Hub's learning account)

sessions.title: Spreadsheets 3: Working with Data
sessions.summary: Sorting, filtering and the IF function; analysing real survey results and turning them into a clear chart.
sessions.needs: Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice Calc or Google Sheets

sessions.title: Presentations & Slide Design
sessions.summary: The speaker and the signboard, the 6-by-6 rule, contrast, layouts and aspect ratio.
sessions.needs: Microsoft PowerPoint, LibreOffice Impress or Google Slides

sessions.title: Presentation Delivery & Public Speaking
sessions.summary: Animations without the carnival, slideshow shortcuts, delivery, citing sources and handling questions.
sessions.needs: Your slides from Session 23 and an audience (friends or family!)

sessions.title: Keyboard Shortcuts & Working Faster
sessions.summary: The 20 shortcuts that save the most time, practised as races, plus screenshots and quick ways to move around.
sessions.needs: A computer with a word processor and a web browser

sessions.title: Skills Lab 3: Office Triathlon
sessions.summary: A timed triathlon: format a school notice, build a club budget with formulas and a chart, analyse survey data with sort, filter and COUNTIF, and make a 4-slide deck.
sessions.needs: Word, Excel and PowerPoint (or LibreOffice or Google equivalents)

sessions.title: Design with Canva
sessions.summary: Posters, flyers and social media graphics: templates, layout, fonts, colour and pictures you are allowed to use.
sessions.needs: Internet and a Canva account (the Hub's learning account)

sessions.title: Photos, Audio & Video
sessions.summary: Take, crop, resize and compress photos; record and trim a voice note; edit a 30-second video with titles.
sessions.needs: A computer or phone with a camera and the Photos or Clipchamp app

sessions.title: Digital Collaboration & Teamwork
sessions.summary: Nnoboa teamwork, sharing permissions, collaborative roles, version history and helpful comments.
sessions.needs: Internet and a shared document tool your mentor sets up

sessions.title: Calendars, Video Calls & Cloud Storage
sessions.summary: Digital calendars and invitations, video meetings and their manners, and managing files in cloud storage.
sessions.needs: Internet and the Hub's learning account

sessions.title: Learning Online
sessions.summary: Google Classroom, finding and judging good tutorials, taking digital notes and studying smarter for senior high school.
sessions.needs: Internet and the Hub's learning account

sessions.title: Smartphones & Tablets
sessions.summary: Android settings, installing apps safely, storage and data bundles, Wi-Fi and hotspots, camera and maps, and Mobile Money safety.
sessions.needs: A smartphone or tablet (the Hub's, or a parent's with permission)

sessions.title: Online Safety & Digital Citizenship
sessions.summary: Personal information, digital footprints, T.H.I.N.K., strong passphrases and spotting phishing.
sessions.needs: A web browser (no real passwords needed)

sessions.title: Social Media & Misinformation
sessions.summary: How feeds choose what you see, fake news and how it spreads, cyberbullying, privacy settings, age limits and healthy use.
sessions.needs: A web browser (no social media account needed)

sessions.title: Skills Lab 4: Connected & Safe
sessions.summary: Practice stations: a Canva poster, a shared document with comments, a meeting invitation, safe sharing, checking a viral post and a privacy clean-up.
sessions.needs: Internet and the Hub's learning account

sessions.title: Block Programming & Algorithms
sessions.summary: The kelewele recipe algorithm, Scratch zones, events, motion blocks and the coordinate stage.
sessions.needs: Scratch (online at scratch.mit.edu or the offline app)

sessions.title: Loops, Decisions & Debugging
sessions.summary: Loops, conditions, sensing, variables, bugs and a clean-up mini-game.
sessions.needs: Scratch (online at scratch.mit.edu or the offline app)

sessions.title: Build a Web Page
sessions.summary: Plan and build a simple website about your community with Google Sites, then a first look at HTML.
sessions.needs: Internet, the Hub's learning account and Notepad

sessions.title: What Is AI? Machines That Learn
sessions.summary: Rules vs learning from examples, training data, AI you already use, why AI makes mistakes and bias.
sessions.needs: A computer with a web browser (no AI account needed)

sessions.title: Using AI Wisely & Safely
sessions.summary: Chatbots, clear prompts, checking AI answers, deepfakes, privacy and honest use of AI for schoolwork.
sessions.needs: A computer with a web browser; an AI tool only with a mentor or a parent

sessions.title: Skills Lab 5: Code & AI Challenge
sessions.summary: Practice stations: a Scratch game from a brief, a one-page website, training the sorting robot and fact-checking AI answers.
sessions.needs: Scratch, a web browser, the Hub's learning account and a textbook or encyclopedia

sessions.title: Capstone Planning & Blueprint
sessions.summary: Choosing a capstone track, the project charter, safe data ethics and prototype v0.1.
sessions.needs: Your team of 3–4 and the tools for your track

sessions.title: Capstone Building, Testing & Iteration
sessions.summary: User testing, useful feedback, version tracking and the build-and-test sprint.
sessions.needs: Your team, your v0.1 files and another team to test them

sessions.title: Showcase Demo Day & Graduation
sessions.summary: The 3-minute pitch formula, stage choreography, the pre-flight checklist and reflection.
sessions.needs: Your team, your finished project and a screen to present on
